data.one_liner: Create views and page transitions using a concentric clipper effect.
data.what_it_does: Provides widgets, clippers, and page routes to implement animated concentric circle transitions between screens or pages. It is especially suited for onboarding flows and custom page navigation.
use_when: You want animated concentric circle transitions for onboarding screens.
You need custom page routes with a scaling circle clipping effect.
avoid_when: You require standard platform-native page transitions.
You need complex physics-based motion engines like Rive or Lottie.
strengths: Easy to integrate PageView and PageRoute options
Visually striking transition effect inspired by Cuberto designs
weaknesses: Limited to concentric circular clipping patterns
Minimal advanced customization options beyond provided parameters

alternatives.name: page_transition
alternatives.why_pick_it: For a wider variety of standard and custom page transition animations.

alternatives.name: lottie
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer designer-crafted vector animations for onboarding.
